methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: The purpose of this work is to modify the fuel supply systems for a TPP switching from solid, liquid, and gas fuel to high-potential CWSP fuels.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Techno-economic and environmental feasibility study of thermal power plants (TPPs) switching from coal/fuel oil/natural gas to coal-water slurries containing petrochemicals (CWSP). It modifies fuel-supply-system schemes, computes fuel/equipment/operating costs and economic gain, and compares NOx/SOx emissions and heat of combustion across fuels. 'Energy performance indicators' appear only as fuel-comparison descriptors; no EnPI/EnB energy-performance measurement model is presented, proposed, evaluated, or characterised (no energy baseline, no indicator construction/normalisation against drivers, no ISO 50001/50006 framing). Fits 'mentions EnPI/EnB only incidentally / no model identified' and 'purely economic energy management without performance measurement'.

paper_type.evidence_quote: in Plant #1, 7 steam generators in Plant #2, and 1 steam generator in Plant #3

stage1.notes: Borderline eligibility: paper repeatedly says 'energy performance indicators' and has 'petrochemicals' in the title, but these are fuel-comparison/fuel-additive terms, not an EnPI/EnB model or a petrochemical case sector. Case sector = thermal power (electricity) generation, outside the closed Level-3B list -> level_3b false. Flag eligibility + paper_type for human adjudication.
